test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. 

Terse
solution:
The correct answer is **"Verbose"**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** We will learn the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• **Terse - **sparing in the use of words; abrupt.

 
 
• ***Eg. ***A* terse* statement
 
 
 
• **Verbose - **containing more words than necessary : WORDY
 
 
• ***Eg.*** A *verbose *reply​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's learn the meaning of other words:

 
• **Succinct -** marked by compact precise expression without wasted words
 
• **Loathe - **to dislike greatly and often with disgust or intolerance 
 
• **Concise -** marked by brevity of expression or statement : free from all elaboration and superfluous detail
